content:
Samir: noticed a big tail latency spike on small decode after yesterday's flash kernel rollout. anyone else seeing this?
Maya: yep, +1. p95 for short prompts (~8 tokens) jumped from ~60ms to ~250ms after the rollout.
Eli: interesting. are these cold KV-cache hits or warm reuse? could be paged attention fallback.
Samir: looks like mixed. when I force kernel variant -> flash_paged_fuse_off the spike disappears. quick numbers: flash_v2a p95=240ms, flash_paged_fuse_off p95=65ms.
Jordan: can you paste a profiling snapshot? sampling or nvprof would help isolate where time is spent.
Samir: perf sampling dump (short):
```
Perf sampling (perf top):
  40% flash_attn_forward
  22% kv_cache_page_fault_handler
  12% memcpy
   8% kernel_launch_overhead
   6% cudaStreamSynchronize
```
PerfBot: regression alert: deploy 2026-03-17 03:12 flagged +180ms p95 on small-decode in prod. tagged eng-runtime.
Maya: hypothesis: fusion on the paged path introduced an extra synchronization point when KV pages are loaded lazily. stack shows `kv_page_lock` around flash kernel launch.
Eli: makes sense. if a decode wants a page that isn't resident, fusion might wait for page load in a sync step. that kills tail for tiny decodes.
Samir: testing routing rule locally: if decode_tokens <= 12 && kv_pages <= 1 -> prefer small_decode_kernel (no fusion). with that, p95 back to ~70ms. also capping continuous batch group to 16 for tiny decodes helps.
Jordan: we should add a microbenchmark harness: synthetic small decode (8 tokens) with kv_pages 0/1/2 on g4/g5 and onprem GPU. capture p50/p95/p99 and flamegraphs.
Maya: I'll add the bench and run across instance types. also instrument span attr `kv_pages` and `kernel_variant` in traces so we can filter later.
Eli: alternative: prefetch KV pages before launching fused kernel (async memcpy + stream sync only when needed). might preserve fusion perf while avoiding stall.
Samir: good idea. try prefetch in the runtime: issue a `cudaMemcpyAsync` for candidate pages and only launch fused kernel when pages signaled ready.
PerfBot: /perf start small-decode-kv-page-sweep (creates run id 7864). include seq_len sweep and kv_page counts.
Jordan: small note: watch out for fallback when seq_len % 64 != 0 -> we hit gpu_pad_kernel path, introduced extra jitter last quarter. include seq_len sweep 4..64.
Maya: will include seq_len and batch_size sweep (batch=1..16). will attach nvprof traces and flamegraphs to the perf run.
Eli: if prefetching works but adds overhead for non-paged cases, gate it: prefetch only when kv_pages > 0 and page residency low.
Samir: created internal issue #4522 and a draft PR with routing rule + instrumented traces. assigning maya for perf runs and eli for kernel change.
Maya: running nightly on onprem cluster now, will drop artifacts here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Samir: thanks — let's triage EOD. please ping with links to flamegraphs and perf run.
Jordan: also add a quick canary rollout plan: route 5% traffic to variant with small_decode_kernel and prefetch fallback, measure p95 for 24h before wider rollout.
Samir: agreed. I'll post the canary plan in #eng-releases after we have perf artifacts.
PerfBot: noted. regression ticket created and linked to perf run 7864.
Maya: ping me if you want me to run extra traces with nvtx ranges around KV page ops.
Eli: will try deferred load approach today and share microprofile.
Samir: ok team, follow ups here. thanks all.
